fact: The DGI says NIF registration is free and that applicants should request the NIF online via the e-NIF platform or else at tax offices.
The DGI lists the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise among the places where a NIF can be requested.
Actualite.cd lists as the first step to a new passport obtaining a NIF by applying on the e-NIF website.
The DGI says taxpayer identification numbers (NIF) are now requested online and generated and validated within minutes, with free physical DGI offices across the country.
